data.why: The repo bundles the exact 1HHO/2HHB PDB pair the README and in-app 'Load example' button use to demonstrate an assembly-mismatch case, so these are handed to the browser as upload files instead of synthesizing new ones.

goals: Compare a mobile and reference structure (PDB/mmCIF) to get a global RMSD and TM-score with per-residue displacement after a single rigid-body alignment
Identify which chains correspond between two assemblies and which chains are unmatched, rather than assuming equal chain counts
Localize where two structures differ structurally via difference hotspots and 3D spatial patches instead of relying on a single whole-structure RMSD
Detect gained and lost residue-residue contacts between the two structures, including inter-chain contact changes
Decompose observed motion per chain into rigid-body movement versus internal deformation
Export a reproducible, auditable result bundle (CSV/JSON/PDB/SVG/PyMOL script) with engine version and input hashes for later verification

review.summary: The tree follows StructDiff Card's own stated workflow closely: chain correspondence and unmatched chains, localised differences, contacts, motion decomposition and an auditable export. The 13 cited screens I checked support it, except one tooltip claim. It needs small fixes before filing: the coordinate-scope wording overstates what the setting does, f1 claims a clear error message the screens don't show, and the headline-metrics and spatial-cluster-table features are missing.
